scope: Full current external publication and post-relocation purge retrieval test review
assessment: External publication binds exact committed descriptor and retrieval proof; approval required before preparing checksum-verified ASC paths
Actual local bare remote retrieval succeeds after original delivery, metadata, working bundle and lifecycle objects are removed
Protected named backend keeps local root out of portable plan; preparation status detects changed bytes after runtime restart without rewriting record
Disposable relocation, quarantine and purge remove redundant files; public CLI restores verified delivery and refuses to overwrite owner destination
limitations: Local disposable filesystem backend and bare remote do not establish durable hosted storage acceptance
Lifecycle metadata and backend remain available during external retrieval; not complete producer environment deletion
Post-purge test removes redundant relocation copies while active package and objects remain; not independent remote recovery after deleting all active storage
Fixture approvals are not real human approval; no ASC upload, real product, cross-filesystem or raw observation privacy assertion
